description: Impervious Surfaces Without Roads is a dataset listed in City of Salinas Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Derived from NearMap aerial imagery. This layer represents impervious surfaces derived from 2025 Nearmap imagery, which may include a small amount of sampling error. Public roads have been excluded from this layer, while roofs and driveways have been included. Disclaimer & Warranties/Accuracy: Areas generated from data processing from oblique aerial imagery by Nearmap. Coverage: Salinas, California. The portal files it under Energy and Environment. Its keywords are impervious surface. The portal shows 1,812 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-03-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cityofsalinas-portal.
